title: Fall 2026 Registration — Check Your Date
details: Priority registration for fall quarter is underway. Open MyPortal, click the Student Registration card and open the Registration Dashboard to find your registration time ticket — then register as early as you can for the best class selection.

title: Last Day of Most 6-Week Summer Classes
details: Most six-week summer session classes finish this week, and your final exam is held on the last day of your class. Summer deadlines vary by section — check your class schedule in MyPortal.

title: International Students: Fall Arrival Prep
details: Arriving for fall quarter? Double-check your I-20 and visa, arrange housing, and watch for International Student Programs' new-student orientation announcements before classes start Sept. 21.

title: 2026-27 Academic Year Begins
details: The new academic year officially begins across the Foothill-De Anza district.
